messages:
olivia-customer: Hey team — seeing intermittent 403s and huge tail latency from our integration since this morning. A bunch of requests are routed to EU and we're getting 200–300ms extra RTT + unexpected egress billing. Sample request-id: `req_9f3a2b`.

maria-support: Sorry about that — can you paste a raw request (headers) and one failing request-id?

olivia-customer: Pasted one above. Here's a curl we used to repro locally: 
```
curl -v \
  -H $'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \
  -H $'X-Client-Region: \xEF\xBB\xBFus-west' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/complete
```
Note the `\xEF\xBB\xBF` — this was inserted by our legacy header sanitizer when concatenating a user input file.

maria-support: thanks. Can you confirm timestamps and another request-id? Also are you using our Node SDK or rolling your own headers?

olivia-customer: Using our in-house proxy; saw these p50/p95 spikes starting 09:12 UTC. Another id `req_9f3a9c`. SDK not used.

kevin-eng-runtime: looking. Can you paste router trace from `req_9f3a9c` if you have it, or I can pull ours.

maria-support: pulling logs now — handing to kevin.

region-router-bot: trace req_9f3a9c: matched route policy -> region header present but unknown token -> fallback to policy `region:eu-fallback` -> edge eu-west-1 selected -> final status 200.

kevin-eng-runtime: interesting — the header is being treated as non-empty, but the router doesn't recognize `\xEF\xBB\xBFus-west` as `us-west` so it falls into the unknown -> eu-fallback path. That explains latency and cross-region routing.

raj-platform: thanks for the data. Two things: (1) why did it return 403 sometimes? (2) billing impact — those EU egress charges could be material.

kevin-eng-runtime: 403s are a separate symptom — some of the edges enforce region-based client ACLs; when region parses to unknown, auth module rejects certain tokens (403). Other edges accept but route to eu, resulting in latency. Root cause seems to be edge header parsing not trimming Unicode BOM and other non-visible whitespace.

maria-support: repro steps for support/eng: use the curl above, confirm router trace shows `unknown token` -> eu-fallback.

kevin-eng-runtime: confirm here: reproduced in staging. Quick debug hex dump of incoming header bytes: `ef bb bf 75 73 2d 77 65 73 74` -> leads to mismatch against expected ascii `us-west`.

olivia-customer: ugh — that sanitizer was from an ancient script. We can strip it on our side but want platform to handle more robustly.

raj-platform: agree. Short-term workaround: set explicit query param `?region=us-west` or use header without BOM. Also if you upgrade to SDK >= v1.4.2 the client will strip BOM automatically.

maria-support: I've logged internal ticket INF-4932 for a platform fix to trim leading/trailing unicode whitespace including BOM on header parsing.

kevin-eng-runtime: plan: patch edge parser to normalize and trim header values (unicode aware) and update router matching logic to canonicalize region tokens. Will rollout canary tonight 23:00 UTC, global rollout in 3 days pending canary results.

billing-team: @olivia-customer — we've reviewed the trace. We'll issue a one-time credit for cross-region egress caused by our fallback routing while the fix is rolling out. Please DM invoice numbers we should apply to.

olivia-customer: thanks, appreciated. We'll also sanitize our proxy asap.

maria-support: summary/action items: 1) customer to sanitize header or use `region` query param / upgrade SDK. 2) eng-runtime will deploy BOM/whitespace trimming + canonicalization (canary 23:00 UTC). 3) billing to issue credits for affected invoice range. 4) support will follow up in 24h with canary results.

kevin-eng-runtime: note for postmortem: add unit tests for unicode trimming, add regression test with byte-level header inputs.

region-router-bot: canary deployment scheduled: INF-4932-canary at 2026-03-19T23:00:00Z.

maria-support: closing loop for now — will reopen if you still see issues after fix. :thumbsup:
